pages.text: Hops and grapes climb a $(item)Trellis$(). Stack trellises on soil and plant on the bottom one: a $(item)hop rhizome$() or a $(item)grape cutting$(). Pick the cones or bunches when they hang ripe; the vine stays. Shears prune grape vines for $(item)grape leaves$().

pages.text: Hops hanging with ripe cones, and a grape vine with its bunches.
